The Ramsey number \(R(K_5,K_{5-e})\) must be at least 25 because \(K_4\subset K_{5-e}\) and \(\,R(K_5,K_4)=25\).  The known literature (Radziszowski’s survey of small Ramsey numbers) records that this lower bound is tight: every 2‑coloring of \(K_{25}\) forces either a red \(K_5\) or a blue copy of \(K_5\) missing a single edge.  Hence the exact value is 25.  The other proposed answers (34 and 22) conflict with the established lower bound and with the published value, so they are incorrect.
